import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ThetaProjectionCoherence

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

section IdentityMapProbe

variable (k : Type u) [Field k]
variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable def probeMId :
    Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) ≅
      𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
  let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))
  have hσ : σ = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k)) := by
    dsimp [σ]
    simp
  NatIso.ofComponents (fun T => Over.isoMk (Iso.refl T.left) (by
    exact (Category.id_comp T.hom).trans
      ((congrArg (fun q => T.hom ≫ q) hσ).trans (Category.comp_id T.hom)).symm)) (fun f => by
      apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
      simp)

@[simp]
theorem probeMId_hom_app_left (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    ((probeMId k).hom.app T).left = 𝟙 T.left := by
  simp [probeMId]

theorem probeSectionsAlgebraMapSelfEq
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.Opens) :
    Over.sectionsAlgebra
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U =
      Over.sectionsAlgebra T U := by
  let iD := Over.sectionsAlgebra
    ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U
  let iT := Over.sectionsAlgebra T U
  change iD = iT
  have tw : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, U) (Algebra.id k).toSMul
      iT.toSMul iD.toSMul := Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T U
  have hi := @IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k Γ(T.left, U) _ _ _
    (Algebra.id k) iT iD tw
  exact Algebra.algebra_ext iD iT fun r =>
    (DFunLike.congr_fun hi r).trans (by rfl)

theorem probeAlgebraEqOfTower {B : Type u} [CommRing B]
    (iT iD : Algebra k B)
    (tw : @IsScalarTower k k B (Algebra.id k).toSMul iT.toSMul iD.toSMul) :
    iD = iT := by
  have hiMap := @IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k B _ _ _
    (Algebra.id k) iT iD tw
  exact Algebra.algebra_ext iD iT fun r =>
    (DFunLike.congr_fun hiMap r).trans (by rfl)

theorem probeFamilyHomEq :
    ∀ (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra k B]
      [IsScalarTower k k B] [IsScalarTower k k B],
      (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C).hom B =
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv).hom B := by
  intro B _ iD iE iT twD twE
  dsimp only [crossBaseTransportFamilyInv, curveTransportFamily]
  exact crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight k C B

theorem probeMixedCurveMapAlg {D E : Over (Spec (.of k))} (g : D ⟶ E)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (iD iE : Algebra k A)
    (twD : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul)
    (twE : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul)
    (φ : @AlgHom k A A _ _ _ iE iD) (hφ : ∀ a, φ a = a)
    (a : @PicEtAff k _ E A _ iE) :
    (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
      D E (curveTransportFamily g) A _ iD iE iE twD twE) a =
      (@PicEtAff.mapAlg k _ D A _ iE A _ iD φ)
        ((@PicEtAff.curveMap k _ D E A _ iE g) a) := by
  have hiMap := @IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k k A _ _ _
    (Algebra.id k) iE iD twD
  have hi : iD = iE := Algebra.algebra_ext iD iE fun r =>
    (DFunLike.congr_fun hiMap r).trans (by rfl)
  subst iD
  have hφ' : φ = AlgHom.id k A := AlgHom.ext hφ
  subst φ
  rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_id]
  rfl

theorem probeMixedCrossBaseMapAlg (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (iD iE : Algebra k A)
    (twD : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul)
    (twE : @IsScalarTower k k A (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul)
    (φ : @AlgHom k A A _ _ _ iE iD) (hφ : ∀ a, φ a = a)
    (a : @PicEtAff k _ ((baseChange k k).obj C) A _ iE) :
    (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _ (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k)
      C ((baseChange k k).obj C) (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C)
      A _ iD iE iE twD twE) a =
      (@PicEtAff.mapAlg k _ C A _ iE A _ iD φ)
        ((@PicEtAff.curveMap k _ C ((baseChange k k).obj C) A _ iE
          ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv) a) := by
  calc
    _ = (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _
        (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k) C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
        A _ iD iE iE twD twE) a :=
      @RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom_congr k k k _ _ _
        (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k) C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C)
        (curveTransportFamily ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv)
        (fun B _ iDB iEB iTB twDB twEB => by
          obtain rfl : iTB = iDB := (probeAlgebraEqOfTower k iTB iDB twDB).symm
          obtain rfl : iTB = iEB := (probeAlgebraEqOfTower k iTB iEB twEB).symm
          dsimp only [crossBaseTransportFamilyInv, curveTransportFamily]
          exact crossBaseAffineIso_inv_eq_whiskerRight k C B)
        A _ iD iE iE twD twE a
    _ = _ := probeMixedCurveMapAlg k ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv
      A iD iE twD twE φ hφ a

theorem probeSectionShuffleSymmTransport (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (U : T.left.Opens)
    (a : PicEtAff ((baseChange k k).obj C) Γ(T.left, U)) :
    (sectionShuffle k k C T U).symm a =
      let iD := Over.sectionsAlgebra
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T) U
      let iE := Over.sectionsAlgebra T U
      let twD : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, U)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul :=
        Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T U
      let twE : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.left, U)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul :=
        @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq k k Γ(T.left, U) _ _ _
          (Algebra.id k) iE iE (fun _ => rfl)
      (@RelPicTransportFamily.picEtAffHom k k _ _ k _
        (Algebra.id k) (Algebra.id k) C ((baseChange k k).obj C)
        (crossBaseTransportFamilyInv k k C) Γ(T.left, U) _
        iD iE iE twD twE) a := by
  rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
theorem probe_map_goal
    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ)
    (lam : pic0Subgroup ((baseChange k k).obj C) T.unop) :
    picEtCrossBaseInv k k C T.unop lam.1 =
      picEtMap C ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop)
        (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T.unop lam.1) := by
  refine picEt.ext fun W => ?_
  rw [picEtCrossBaseInv_val, picEtMap_val]
  have hW : W.1 ≤ ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop).left ⁻¹ᵁ W.1 := by
    rw [probeMId_hom_app_left]
    exact le_rfl
  calc
    (sectionShuffle k k C T.unop W.1).symm (lam.1.1 ⟨W.1, W.2⟩) =
        PicEtAff.mapAlg C
          (Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop) W.1 W.1 hW)
          ((picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T.unop lam.1).1 W) := by
      rw [picEtPullback_val, probeSectionShuffleSymmTransport]
      dsimp only
      let iD := Over.sectionsAlgebra
        ((Over.map (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k)))).obj T.unop) W.1
      let iE := Over.sectionsAlgebra T.unop W.1
      have twD : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iD.toSMul :=
        Over.isScalarTower_sections_map k k T.unop W.1
      have twE : @IsScalarTower k k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1)
          (Algebra.id k).toSMul iE.toSMul iE.toSMul :=
        @IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq k k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1) _ _ _
          (Algebra.id k) iE iE (fun _ => rfl)
      let φ : @AlgHom k Γ(T.unop.left, W.1) Γ(T.unop.left, W.1)
          _ _ _ iE iD :=
        Over.appLEAlgHom ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop) W.1 W.1 hW
      have hφ : ∀ s, φ s = s := by
        intro s
        change ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop).left.appLE W.1 W.1 hW s = s
        rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE_congr_hom (probeMId_hom_app_left k T.unop)
          W.1 W.1 hW le_rfl]
        rw [Scheme.Hom.appLE, Scheme.Hom.id_app]
        have he : (homOfLE (le_rfl : W.1 ≤ W.1)).op = 𝟙 _ := rfl
        rw [he, Functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
        rfl
      exact probeMixedCrossBaseMapAlg k C _ iD iE twD twE φ hφ _
    _ = picEtMapVal C ((probeMId k).hom.app T.unop)
          (picEtPullback ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).inv T.unop lam.1) W :=
      by sorry

end IdentityMapProbe

end AlgebraicGeometry
